1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 112px channel; 27px/s forward speed; 6 locally deforming knots under a shared current; 230px lookahead; inertial response 8/s.
1.natural_language: Move the pointer across the scope to inspect concealed channel sections. Amber dashed outlines retain the first scan; green walls and echoes show current motion in scanned sections. Inspection also works during flight. Launch the probe and keep it between the green channel walls until it reaches EXIT. The probe has inertia; each steering control advances one fixed 240 ms slice, and the walls and current update in that slice while waiting keeps the current state stable. Drag to steer in full mode; click a desired height in simplified mode. Preview scans and recoverable steering corrections are allowed. A wall touch or rejected CERTIFY TRACE ends the episode. The 180-second task limit includes preview. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden implementation access. simplified.summary: Hover across the scope to inspect and retain the same local sonar information as full mode; click a desired height to steer the identical inertial control pen.

full.summary: Hover across the scope to inspect and retain the same local sonar information as simplified mode; drag the control pen to steer. Releasing keeps its last target and the world advancing.
